insight: Paris-based, founded in 2024 by ex-Spotify/Lyft/McKinsey alumni; raised a $10M seed led by Gradient in 2026.
name: Linkup
tagline: Production-grade web search API for AI agents.
description: A web search API built for LLMs and agents. Linkup returns sourced, cited answers with full-text snippets in seconds, plus a Fetch endpoint for URL extraction and a Research endpoint that runs multi-step, chain-of-thought deep research. It integrates via MCP and SDK wrappers for OpenAI, LangChain, CrewAI, and more, and offers zero-data-retention enterprise hosting.

modelSupport.notes: A search API that grounds any LLM; no model selection of its own.

edge: Tops OpenAI's SimpleQA benchmark for grounded answers, with per-request pricing and a multi-step deep-research endpoint.
cons: Deep research can cost up to $2.50/call
